from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A specific liability figure extracted from a financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the report covers (e.g., '2022', '2023')")
    line_item_name: str | None = Field(description="The label of the financial line item (e.g., 'Total Liabilities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported numerical value for the line item")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, if specified (e.g., 'USD', '$')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_records: list[LiabilityRecord]
